concepts.title: Available / blink
concepts.summary: A relaxed smile, then a soft lid closure. The eye closes in its own shape without rotating.

poses.label: Open
poses.direction: Warm open C eyes, tiny relaxed closed smile. This is the identity anchor.
limitations: Native output is 1254×1254 despite requested 1024×1024; retained without code resizing.
Nominal hex palette and requested pixel geometry are approximate; faint generated texture persists despite a targeted flat-colour cleanup.

poses.label: Lower lids
poses.direction: Both eyelids lower naturally, same eye centres and eye angle. Reduce aperture, do not squash the entire eye.
limitations: Generated concept edit visually preserves the mouth, eye spacing and lower eye arcs; exact pixel equality is not asserted.
Palette/background inherit the anchor's slight generated texture.

poses.label: Closed
poses.direction: Two short gently curved closed lids, same eye centres. Same small resting smile.
limitations: Two gently curved closed lid strokes preserve the original centres and mouth visually; exact pixel equality is not asserted.
Palette/background inherit the anchor's slight generated texture.

concepts.cycle: Open → lower lids → closed → lower lids → open; hold the open pose between occasional blinks.
concepts.framePolicy: Use four or more authored closing/reopening cels within the longer idle cycle; preserve a brief natural blink instead of stretching it to 12 moving cels.
limitations: Three separately generated static key poses, not a completed animation; no timing, in-between frames or runtime integration is claimed.
No image was resized, redrawn or edited with code. Project assets are exact copied ImageGen artifacts.
Independent generated edits may retain subtle texture and small drawing variations; production animation continuity remains future work.

concepts.title: Listening
concepts.summary: Attention arrives through the eyes. Keep the mouth closed so listening cannot read as talking.

poses.label: Notice
poses.direction: Open C eyes, closed almost-flat friendly mouth. Neutral direct attention.
poses.limitations: No material visual defect observed; upper-lid acting remains restrained.

poses.label: Focus
poses.direction: One upper eyelid lifts slightly, both dark apertures direct attention slightly to the viewer’s left. Mouth stays small and closed.
poses.limitations: The focus is communicated by modest upper-lid asymmetry. A directional gaze shift is subtle in the pupil-free C-eye design.

poses.label: Hold
poses.direction: Balanced open eyes settle with a slightly intent gaze. Mouth remains a closed short dash, no sound-wave mouth.
poses.limitations: No material visual defect observed; upper-lid acting remains restrained.

concepts.cycle: Notice → focus → settled hold; a tiny gaze adjustment during long listening, then return to neutral.
concepts.limitations: Static key poses only. Notice, asymmetrical focus, and balanced attentive hold are visibly distinct through upper-lid height. The pupil-free design gives only a subtle impression of leftward attention. All three preserve the shared anchor style, placement and closed dash mouth.

concepts.title: Thinking
concepts.summary: One relaxed half-lid, then the other: a small gesture of weighing an idea. Keep the mouth closed.

poses.label: Take in
poses.direction: Balanced open C eyes, closed neutral short mouth.
poses.limitations: No visual defect found; neutral baseline pose.

poses.label: Consider
poses.direction: LEFT eye upper lid clearly lowered to halve the dark aperture height; RIGHT eye remains open C. Same centres and outer widths. Closed mouth angles a little. No whole-eye rotation or detached eyebrow.
poses.limitations: No blocking visual defect found. The dark aperture is approximately half height; exact lid height remains hand-shaped.

poses.label: Reconsider
poses.direction: RIGHT eye upper lid clearly lowered to halve the dark aperture height; LEFT eye returns to open C. Same centres and outer widths. Closed short mouth returns level. No whole-eye rotation or detached eyebrow.
poses.limitations: No blocking visual defect found. The dark aperture is slightly taller than pose 2's; both read clearly as half-lidded eyes.

concepts.cycle: Take in → consider with left lid lowered → reconsider with right lid lowered; irregular holds and occasional quiet blink.
concepts.limitations: Three static key poses only. Thinking is shown by visibly alternating half-lidded C eyes and a short angled middle mouth; these poses make no directional pupil-gaze claim. Native lid shapes vary slightly in aperture height. No runtime animation was produced.

concepts.title: Warm → thoughtful
concepts.summary: A transition that keeps eye centres fixed and relaxes the smile before the thinking gaze.

poses.label: Warm
poses.direction: Warm balanced open C eyes, small closed smile.
poses.limitations: Native generated contours have small hand-shaped differences from the shared anchor.

poses.label: Between
poses.direction: One lid lowers a little, other eye stays open. Mouth has relaxed into an almost-flat closed stroke. No double eyes or double mouth; no crossfade ghosts.
poses.limitations: The relaxed almost-flat mouth has minor native contour and vertical registration variation; it remains visually centred with the anchor face.

poses.label: Thoughtful
poses.direction: One lid lowered, opposite eye mildly raised, both dark apertures turn subtly up-left. Short angled neutral closed mouth; no happy smile.
poses.limitations: Up-left attention is deliberately subtle in the pupil-free C-eye design. Native hand-shaped contours and mouth registration vary slightly; final animation will need deliberate drawn registration.

concepts.cycle: Warm → between → thoughtful, with drawn in-betweens. Interruptible into listening without double silhouettes.
concepts.limitations: Three static concept key poses, not a full animation. Native ImageGen preserves the face layout visually, with small contour and mouth registration differences. The pupil-free up-left gaze is restrained. Full drawn in-betweens and precise animation registration remain outside this pass.

concepts.title: Speaking / warm
concepts.summary: Warm eyelids and restrained mouth articulation. Mouth timing will follow actual playback.

poses.label: Rest
poses.direction: Warm open C eyes, small closed relaxed smile.
poses.limitations: Compared with the shared anchor, mouth bounding-box centre is 3.5 px higher and smile width is 17 px greater; eye centres differ by at most 0.5 px. This is a shape reference, not a completed viseme set or animation.

poses.label: Soft vowel
poses.direction: Exact same eyes and gaze. A compact lightly rounded open vowel mouth, with slightly lifted corners and a dark interior. No teeth or tongue; modest width.
poses.limitations: Mouth bounding-box centre is 2 px higher than pose 1. Both eye bounds match pose 1 at the measured bright-cyan threshold. This compact aperture is a shape reference.

poses.label: Rounded vowel
poses.direction: Exact same eyes and gaze. A compact rounded O-like open mouth, slightly narrower than soft vowel, in the same mouth centre. Keep friendly attitude in the eyes.
poses.limitations: Mouth bounding-box centre is 5.5 px higher than pose 1; horizontal centre varies by 0.5 px. Right-eye bounding box contracts by 1 px at its right edge, causing a measured 0.5 px centre variation. No visible whole-face drift.

concepts.cycle: Rest, soft vowel and rounded vowel are shape references; final speech selects emotion-specific visemes using the playback clock.
concepts.limitations: Three key-pose shape references for audio-driven warm speech only. They are not a repeating speech loop, complete viseme set, or twelve-frame animation. Exact pixel invariance is not claimed: generated eye contours vary by 1 px across the trio and mouth bounding-box vertical centres vary by up to 5.5 px. The native 1254×1254 image dimensions and faint anchor texture are preserved.

concepts.title: Speaking / calm
concepts.summary: The same speech range with a neutral mouth attitude. No smile leaking into serious speech.

poses.label: Rest
poses.direction: Attentive slightly lowered C lids, closed short flat mouth. Calm neutral concern, not angry or sad.
poses.limitations: A single upper-lid repair made the calm lowered-lid attitude more explicit. This is a static resting shape reference; temporal interpolation has not been assessed.

poses.label: Soft vowel
poses.direction: Exact same eyes and gaze. Compact open neutral vowel mouth with flat upper edge and neutral corners, dark interior. No smiling corners, no tongue or teeth.
poses.limitations: The soft-vowel outline has a gently curved lower edge and restrained level corners. It is a shape reference rather than a phoneme-specific viseme.

poses.label: Rounded vowel
poses.direction: Exact same eyes and gaze. Small rounded O-like mouth at same centre. Eye attitude stays calm and attentive, no happy change.
poses.limitations: The rounded mouth is near circular and narrower than the soft vowel. It is a static articulation reference; audio timing has not been assessed.

concepts.cycle: These are neutral speech shape references; final visemes preserve the selected emotional mouth family.
concepts.limitations: Three independently generated native static key-pose concepts for future audio-driven serious speech. The triple preserves calm eye attitude and neutral mouth attitude, but it is not a full viseme family, animation, repeating loop, or playback-synchronised runtime asset. The triple is slightly brighter and more saturated in cyan than the anchor. Minor generative contour and faint texture variations remain possible.

concepts.title: Coding
concepts.summary: Focused eyelids and a small terminal cursor, kept well away from the eyes.

poses.label: Read code
poses.direction: Two mildly lowered upper lids with C-eye lower arcs, short flat closed mouth. Small thin cyan terminal outline at lower-right containing two tiny chevrons and a short cursor.
poses.limitations: Upper lids are visibly focused rather than fully open; the initial doubled lower arcs were corrected in one targeted edit.

poses.label: Work
poses.direction: Same eyes glance briefly down-right toward terminal. Terminal remains rigid and exactly positioned; cursor shifts down one small row. No new lines appear randomly.
poses.limitations: The down-right gaze change is very subtle; the cursor moving down one row is the strongest working cue.

poses.label: Resolve
poses.direction: Eyes lift slightly but stay focused, mouth is a tiny restrained smile. Terminal stays identical; cursor at the end of its row.
poses.limitations: The upper lid lift is small; the closed smile and cursor at the lower-row end provide the resolution beat.

concepts.cycle: Read → work → resolve; loop the cursor and gaze while work is running, settle when done.
concepts.limitations: Three static concept poses only. Gaze shifts are subtle. The terminal frame and two chevrons are visually rigid across the sequence; image generation does not guarantee identical antialiasing or texture pixels. No runtime or live animation pack was changed.

concepts.title: Reading
concepts.summary: A stable open book, eyes scan across it. No page flip or blank page appearing.

poses.label: Start line
poses.direction: Open C eyes glance down-left. Short calm closed mouth. A small open cyan outline book below and right of the face, with exactly three stable short cyan text strokes on each page.
poses.limitations: Down-left gaze is subtle. The stable book is slightly broader than the prompt's requested bounds, but remains fully below and clear of the face.

poses.label: Across line
poses.direction: Same geometry, eyes glance down-right. The exact same rigid book remains in the same position, all three text strokes stay on both pages.
poses.limitations: Down-right aperture shift is subtle. A generated second eye gap was repaired before selection; selected eye is a single connected C.

poses.label: Next line
poses.direction: Eyes glance slightly down-left, a little lower than first. Same closed mouth, same book, same six visible text strokes; nothing flips, disappears or changes sides.
poses.limitations: Next-line down-left change is subtle; the lower next-line move is not clearly legible from the still. The viewer-right inner eye contour has a small hand-shaped cusp, with no extra gap or detached mark.

concepts.cycle: Start line → across line → next line → across line; stable book throughout.
concepts.limitations: All three selected native images retain the fully open lower-right book and exactly three visible cyan strokes on each page. There is no blank page, page flip or side swap. Eye-aperture changes are restrained and may need clearer drawn in-betweens for a future animation; these are static key-pose concepts only. Book and facial layout are visually stable, not claimed pixel-identical after generative edits.

concepts.title: Writing / drafting
concepts.summary: A pen follows one short stroke. The ink remains visible through the action.

poses.label: Prepare
poses.direction: Focused half-lidded C eyes, short closed mouth. Small simple cyan pen and tiny outlined note at lower-right, one tiny initial ink stroke.
poses.limitations: The initial ink is a short curve rather than a point. The prop remains secondary in the lower-right.

poses.label: Draw
poses.direction: Exact same face and rigid note. Pen tip advances along a short gently curving ink line; keep all initial ink and extend it. No letters or words.
poses.limitations: The pen advance is small, suited to a middle key pose.

poses.label: Finish
poses.direction: Eyes relax slightly, short restrained closed smile. Same note, pen rests at the end of the completed curved line; ink stays visible.
poses.limitations: The finish raises the curved upper lids and gives a shallow closed smile; minor generated contour variation remains.

concepts.cycle: Prepare → draw → finish; hold finished ink, then exit before a new sheet appears.
concepts.limitations: Three static key poses only. The same note stays fixed and the abstract ink grows from left to right across all three; drawn in-betweens are still needed for a finished animation.

concepts.title: Searching
concepts.summary: Eyes follow a small magnifier in the lower corner. Keep its circle away from both eyes.

poses.label: Look left
poses.direction: C eyes glance gently left, closed flat mouth. Small thin cyan magnifying glass at lower-right with generous empty space between its circle and the right eye.
poses.limitations: The left gaze is conveyed by both C openings facing left. Small native eye-contour differences remain relative to the shared anchor.

poses.label: Sweep
poses.direction: Eyes glance gently right. Magnifying glass moves only a small distance right within the lower-right corner, never near the eyes. Keep same scale and handle angle.
poses.limitations: The right gaze is conveyed by both C openings facing right. The magnifier ring is slightly larger and thicker than pose 1; its handle angle and low-right placement stay consistent.

poses.label: Find
poses.direction: Eyes become evenly attentive, mouth is a tiny closed smile. Magnifying glass settles at the midpoint of its short track, below eye height and clear of mouth.
poses.limitations: The magnifier ring is slightly larger and thicker than pose 1 and settles a few pixels beyond the visual midpoint of the short track. The closed smile sits slightly higher than the flat mouth in poses 1 and 2.

concepts.cycle: Look left → sweep → find; use a short search sweep, then settle or continue with irregular holds.
concepts.limitations: These are three static key poses, not a finished animation. Small native contour, icon stroke/size, midpoint and mouth-centre drift remains; the magnifier stays well below both eyes and clear of the mouth in every selected pose.

concepts.title: Got it
concepts.summary: A small recognition beat, then settle. No permanent grin or bouncing after every reply.

poses.label: Receive
poses.direction: Open C eyes, short calm closed mouth.
poses.limitations: Generated contours and tonal texture differ slightly from the anchor; visual inspection confirms stable layout rather than pixel-identical registration.

poses.label: Recognise
poses.direction: Both upper lids lift a little, apertures brighten through wider openings. Small warm closed smile, no open mouth.
poses.limitations: The upper-lid opening is deliberately subtle; the shallow closed smile carries most of the recognition beat.

poses.label: Settle
poses.direction: Eyes soften slightly, relaxed closed smile. Same centres and scale, no face jumping.
poses.limitations: The settled mouth is shallow and nearly flat, with softly lowered upper inner eye contours; native contour differences remain slight.

concepts.cycle: Receive → recognise → settle; play once only when acknowledgement is useful.
concepts.limitations: Three static native key poses only. Receive to recognise to settle is designed as one small acknowledgement beat; drawn in-betweens and playback timing are outside this pass. Eye and mouth centres remain visually stable, with minor generated contour variation rather than pixel-identical registration.

concepts.title: Concern / empathy
concepts.summary: A quiet change in the lids and mouth, followed by an attentive listening hold.

poses.label: Notice
poses.direction: Open C eyes, small neutral horizontal closed mouth.
poses.limitations: No visible blocking defects. Generated edge and texture detail is not pixel-identical between poses.

poses.label: Concern
poses.direction: Upper lids angle subtly inward to create gentle concern, not angry sharp brows. Small shallow downturned closed mouth. Keep C apertures readable and original eye centres.
poses.limitations: No visible blocking defects. Generated edge and texture detail is not pixel-identical between poses.

poses.label: Stay with you
poses.direction: Lids relax a little but keep concerned attitude, one eye slightly more open. Small almost-flat closed mouth, no grin. Attentive quiet gaze.
poses.limitations: No visible blocking defects. Generated edge and texture detail is not pixel-identical between poses.

concepts.cycle: Notice → concern → attentive hold; do not loop a sad reaction during the conversation.
concepts.limitations: Three static key poses. Concern is deliberately mild and carried by upper contours and mouth shape. In-between motion and timing have not been drawn or validated.

steps: Draw separated eyes, mouths and in-betweens
Test loops, transitions, speech and interruptions
Enable one verified family with fallback
